title: A US health care payer pays for a psychedelic medicine
proposition: A US health insurer or public health program publishes a coverage policy or bulletin that pays for a psychedelic medicine.

title: A US licence lets adults legally buy psychedelics for unsupervised personal use
proposition: A United States federal or state law, regulation or programme takes effect under which an adult who holds a licence may lawfully buy a psychedelic drug and take it without medical supervision.

title: A regulator outside the United States approves MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD
proposition: A medicines regulator outside the United States approves midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: About 6,000 to 7,000 psychedelic clinics in the United States
proposition: The number of clinics in the United States that deliver an approved psychedelic-assisted therapy is about 6,500 by the period end, per the named series.

title: About 6,000 psychedelic clinics in Europe
proposition: The number of clinics in Europe that deliver an approved psychedelic-assisted therapy is about 6,000 by the period end, per the named series.

title: Spravato 2026 sales at or above US$3 billion
proposition: Worldwide net sales of Spravato (esketamine nasal spray) in calendar year 2026 are at or above US$3 billion, per Johnson & Johnson's reported product sales.
